title: A Non-Decoupled Time-Domain Direct Sampling Method for Inverse Elastic Medium Scattering
summary: This work is concerned with an inverse medium problem for elastic waves, in which unknown inhomogeneities are reconstructed from time-resolved boundary measurements. We propose a novel time-domain direct sampling method for locating scatterers from a single incident source, without imposing specific assumptions on the temporal profile of the excitation.
